channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় দৈনিক প্রাণহানি ও আহতের নতুন পরিসংখ্যান প্রকাশ
item.description: স্বাস্থ্য অধিদপ্তরের একটি সমীক্ষায় উঠে এসেছে যে সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় দেশে প্রতিদিন গড়ে ৬৬ জনের প্রাণহানি এবং ১০৪ জন স্থায়ীভাবে পঙ্গুত্ববরণ করছেন। সব ধরনের আঘাতজনিত মৃত্যুর ক্ষেত্রে পথদুর্ঘটনাকেই প্রধান কারণ হিসেবে চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে।

item.title: বikaner হাউসের প্রদর্শনী থেকে প্রিয়াঙ্কা গান্ধীর ছেলের ছবি সরানোর অভিযোগ
item.description: দিল্লির তরুণদের আন্দোলন নিয়ে তৈরি শিল্পকর্ম প্রদর্শনী শুরুর আগেই সরিয়ে নিতে বাধ্য করার দাবি জানিয়েছেন প্রিয়াঙ্কা গান্ধীর পুত্র। সংবেদনশীল বিষয়বস্তু থাকার কারণ দেখিয়ে বিকানের হাউসের কর্তৃপক্ষ এই প্রদর্শনী থেকে ছবিগুলো অপসারণ করে।

item.title: আজকের টেলিভিশন পর্দার খেলাধুলার তালিকা
item.description: আজ থেকে শুরু হচ্ছে নিউজিল্যান্ড ও ভারতের মধ্যকার টি-টোয়েন্টি সিরিজ। এছাড়া পাকিস্তানের ত্রিদেশীয় টুর্নামেন্টে মুখোমুখি হবে ইংল্যান্ড ও শ্রীলঙ্কা, এবং রাতে রয়েছে ইউরোপা লিগের ম্যাচ।

item.title: বিয়ে নিয়ে নিজের মানসিক প্রস্তুতির কথা জানালেন নুসরাত ফারিয়া
item.description: চলচ্চিত্র ও গান নিয়ে ব্যস্ত সময় কাটানো চিত্রনায়িকা নুসরাত ফারিয়া জানিয়েছেন তিনি এখন বিয়ের জন্য মানসিকভাবে প্রস্তুত হচ্ছেন। অভিনয় জীবনে বৈচিত্র্য আনতে তিনি যেকোনো পরিবর্তনেও রাজি আছেন।

item.title: ইউরোপের যেসব দেশে শিক্ষার্থীরা পড়াশোনার পাশাপাশি বেশি কাজ করেন
item.description: ইউরোপীয় ইউনিয়নের দেশগুলোর মধ্যে নেদারল্যান্ডস, ডেনমার্ক এবং জার্মানিতে শিক্ষার্থীরা পড়ালেখার পাশাপাশি চাকরির সঙ্গে সবচেয়ে বেশি যুক্ত থাকেন। শিক্ষা অর্জনের পাশাপাশি এই দেশগুলোতে শিক্ষার্থীদের কর্মসংস্থানের হার বেশ উঁচুতে রয়েছে।

item.title: গ্যালিলিও, কোপার্নিকাস ও নিউটনের দুর্লভ বই নিলামে উঠছে
item.description: মহাবিশ্বের রহস্য উন্মোচনে ভূমিকা রাখা গ্যালিলিও, কোপার্নিকাস এবং নিউটনের ঐতিহাসিক গ্রন্থগুলো নিলামে বিক্রি হতে যাচ্ছে। ১৫৪৩ থেকে ১৬৮৭ সালের মধ্যে প্রকাশিত এই বিরল সংগ্রহগুলো কিনতে প্রায় ২০ লাখ ডলার খরচ হতে পারে।

item.title: ৪৫তম বিসিএসে বাদ পড়া প্রার্থীদের রি-ভেরিফিকেশনের আশ্বাস প্রতিমন্ত্রীর
item.description: ৪৫তম বিসিএস পরীক্ষায় চূড়ান্ত সুপারিশপ্রাপ্ত হওয়ার পরও বাদ পড়া কিছু প্রার্থী রাষ্ট্রীয় অবিচারের অভিযোগ তুললে প্রতিমন্ত্রী তাদের পুনরায় যাচাই-বাছাই বা রি-ভেরিফিকেশন করার আশ্বাস প্রদান করেন।

item.title: স্বাস্থ্য ও ফিটনেস রক্ষায় খাদ্যাভ্যাস নিয়ে বৈজ্ঞানিক দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি
item.description: ওজন নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং পেশি গঠনে খাদ্যের পুষ্টিমানের পাশাপাশি খাওয়ার সঠিক সময় ও পরিমাণ অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। খালি পেটে ফল খাওয়া কিংবা রাতে ভাত বা দুধ খাওয়ার মতো প্রচলিত বিভিন্ন ধারণার পেছনে বৈজ্ঞানিক ভিত্তি রয়েছে।

item.title: Hot Wheels отмечает, что предсказал трюки Илона Маска еще в 1968 году
item.description: Производитель игрушек Hot Wheels опубликовал в Facebook пост. В нем утверждается, что концепт летающего автомобиля бренда уже выполнял трюки, аналогичные демонстрации Tesla Roadster.

item.title: Видео блогера из Дели вызвало политический скандал в Трипуре
item.description: Ролик инфлюенсера Амира Шокеена с насмешками над молодым представителем племени вызвал волну возмущения. Политические деятели осудили инцидент как расовое нападение и потребовали немедленных мер.

item.title: Delhi High Court Schedules Neha Bora's Plea for Oct 22
item.description: The Delhi High Court will review Neha Bora's petition challenging a peace bond notice on October 22. She requested the notice be cancelled and police restrained from taking coercive measures.

item.title: Два пляжа Сиднея закрыли из-за выброшенного на берег кита
item.description: Власти закрыли для купания пляжи Куджи и Марубра в качестве меры предосторожности. Городской совет планирует уважительно по отношению к культуре убрать останки животного с побережья.

item.title: В Карнатаке выпустили уведомление об изъятии земель для метро
item.description: Властями штата опубликовано третье уведомление об изъятии участков общей площадью свыше 13 тысяч квадратных метров для реализации проекта метрополитена.

item.title: Президент Колумбии убирает из Национального музея коммунистические работы
item.description: Глава государства Абелардо де ла Эспрьельи заявил о начале культурной контрреволюции. В рамках этой инициативы из Национального музея удаляют экспонаты, продвигающие коммунистические идеи.

item.title: Трамп вновь критикует морскую ветроэнергетику
item.description: Позиция американского лидера ставит под угрозу межпартийную сделку. Соглашение было направлено на ускорение процедур одобрения новых инфраструктурных и энергетических проектов.

item.title: США эвакуируют часть дипломатов из Саудовской Аравии из-за хуситов
item.description: Госдепартамент распорядился о выезде сотрудников дипмиссии из королевства. Причиной стали сохраняющиеся угрозы нападений со стороны йеменского движения хуситов.

item.title: Нил Буш поддержал кандидата-демократа на выборах в Техасе
item.description: Брат бывшего президента США сообщил, что отдал голос за демократа Джеймса Таларико. Такое решение он принял из-за сомнений в кандидатуре республиканца Кена Пакстона.

item.title: Mumbai Police serve summons to 24 X profiles regarding Bhatia film
item.description: On October 18, local authorities in Mumbai sent formal notices to 24 social media accounts on X. This action followed a public outcry over a documentary featuring controversial assertions concerning Prime Minister Narendra Modi and businessman Gautam Adani.

item.title: Swati Chaudhary wins silver medal in archery at Asian Para Games
item.description: Archer Swati Chaudhary secured a silver medal in the women's W1 individual tournament at the Asian Para Games. After holding a 4-2 advantage early on, she was defeated in the final match by China's Cen Mengkan.

item.title: Russia Frees Jailed American Citizen Amid Envoy Talks
item.description: Russian authorities liberated American citizen Stephen Hubbard following a formal request from the United States. The release coincided with discussions between Russian leadership and a US envoy regarding Ukraine.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh election authority pauses local body polls
item.description: Following a directive from the Supreme Court, the State Election Commission in Andhra Pradesh has suspended the electoral process for 100 urban local bodies. Officials announced that further instructions will be released on October 22 once district and police reports are reviewed.

item.title: Nighttime Russian missile strikes injure six individuals in Kyiv
item.description: Ukrainian officials reported that overnight missile attacks by Russia injured six people in Kyiv and drove residents into bunkers on Thursday. The assault occurred shortly after Moscow indicated an openness to US-brokered peace discussions, with President Donald Trump noting talks were nearing a stage of progress.

item.title: Publisher Boréal cuts ties with author Thélyson Orélien over AI claims
item.description: Canadian publishing house Boréal has severed its business relationship with Haitian Canadian novelist Thélyson Orélien following accusations that he used artificial intelligence to write his book. Orélien, whose work was previously dropped from France's Prix Goncourt selection, has consistently denied these allegations.

item.title: U.P. CM Yogi issues directions for strict legal action in cases of land encroachment
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Officials must impose strict legal action on anyone who illegally occupies land or dispossesses vulnerable people. Key points: Yogi, Officials, strict, legal.

item.title: Delhi Jal Board plans defoamer spraying to tackle Yamuna river froth
item.description: To combat thick toxic foam layers accumulating on the Yamuna river ahead of the Chhath festival, the Delhi Jal Board is scheduled to apply chemical defoaming agents in the upcoming weeks.

item.title: Former reality television personality Sam Wood seeks bail in supreme court
item.description: Ex-reality star and wellness figure Sam Wood has applied to the Queensland supreme court for bail. He faces domestic violence allegations, including claims that he assaulted and choked his wife in Noosa.

item.title: Indian swimmer faces suspension amid misconduct allegations at Games
item.description: An Indian swimmer at the Asian Para Games is facing a potential ban following a serious sexual offense allegation. A senior Paralympic Committee of India official condemned the incident as intolerable, confirming that officials managed the situation directly in Nagoya.

item.title: Supreme Court Rules Out Judicial Directives for Custodial Interrogation
item.description: The top court emphasized that courts should not dictate whether investigators should use custodial interrogation. This ruling highlights the autonomy given to investigative authorities in choosing how to question suspects.

item.title: Glee Musical Series Set for Streaming Revival with Original Actors
item.description: The musical television show Glee is returning for a streaming platform reboot featuring returning cast members. Creator Ryan Murphy is currently writing the script to recreate the original appeal of the program.

item.title: Organizing International Football Matches in India Involves Complex Logistics
item.description: Bringing national teams like Brazil, Uruguay, and Panama to play friendly matches in India requires extensive financial and logistical planning. Promoters manage multiple elements, including sponsorship, ticket sales, and securing participating teams.

item.title: WMO Warns Upcoming El Nino Event May Reach Record Intensity
item.description: The World Meteorological Organization reported that tropical Pacific sea surface temperatures could surge up to 3.8 degrees Celsius above normal. This significant rise is projected to occur between November 2026 and January 2027.

item.title: Suvendu Adhikari States Only Sanatanis Will Participate in Durga Immersions
item.description: BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari stated that Durga idol immersions at 27 Ganges ghats will involve only Sanatanis, devoid of communal intent. Local authorities have deployed numerous municipal officials, medical teams, and disaster relief units for the event.

item.title: Report Connects Civil Unrest in France and India Through Coordinated Networks
item.description: An investigation by senior editor Asra Nomani points to 101 entities across nine nations. These groups form a combined network that allegedly organizes or amplifies protests across Europe.

item.title: Attack at Saudi Arabia's King Fahd Airport Leaves One Dead and Eight Hurt
item.description: An assault on Saudi Arabia's King Fahd airport resulted in one fatality and eight injuries. The wounded individuals were promptly taken to medical facilities while aviation authorities promised further updates.

item.title: Russia Agrees to Trilateral Negotiations Amid US Statements on Ukraine Conflict
item.description: Donald Trump stated the Ukraine conflict is nearing a resolution as Russia agreed to restart trilateral discussions. US envoy Steve Witkoff commended Vladimir Putin for releasing American citizen Stephen Hubbard.

item.title: Dipke Praises Released Leaders Following Jantar Mantar Detention
item.description: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das walked free after their judicial remand ended. The two had been detained following an October 14 demonstration at Jantar Mantar.

item.title: Mammootty and Adoor Gopalakrishnan Team Up for Padayaatra
item.description: Actor Mammootty and director Adoor Gopalakrishnan are uniting after 32 years for the film Padayaatra. The movie, focusing on a doctor pursuing an ethical life, hits theaters on December 4, 2026.

item.title: Crazy Kalyanam Box Office Collections Drop on Day Four
item.description: The Telugu romantic comedy Crazy Kalyanam earned 15 lakhs on October 19, bringing its four-day total to 74 lakhs. This marks a significant revenue decline from the previous day despite initial interest.

item.title: Tesla Plans to Launch Cybercab Sales Before Year's End
item.description: Tesla announced plans to offer its autonomous, steering-wheel-free Cybercab to buyers by December. This rollout proceeds while federal authorities examine the vehicle's compliance with safety regulations.

item.title: Deadly Saudi Airport Strike Leads to US Diplomat Departures
item.description: Washington ordered certain diplomats and family members out of Saudi Arabia following a fatal airport attack. The directive came amid rising Houthi assaults originating from Yemen.

item.title: Global Leaders Highlight Critical PHP Software Flaws
item.description: Artificial intelligence helped uncover two security flaws affecting the PHP programming language, which powers roughly 70 percent of all web pages.

item.title: Morning News Briefing: Political Queries and Court Hearings
item.description: Key stories include Rahul Gandhi questioning the release timing of an Epstein-Puri photo and the Delhi High Court addressing Neha Bora's petition regarding a peace bond.

item.title: Delhi Dussehra Fair Ride Incident Claims 27-Year-Old Woman's Life
item.description: A 27-year-old woman named Gudiya died from injuries sustained during an amusement ride accident at a Dussehra fair in Delhi. She passed away while receiving care at Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital.

item.title: Iran Shifts Military Strategy
item.description: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced a shift toward an offensive defensive doctrine. Tehran stated it would launch invasions against any nation that initiates aggression against it.

item.title: Four Suspects Detained Over Tiger Shroff Shooting
item.description: Authorities transferred four suspects to the Anti-Extortion Cell following a shooting incident targeting actor Tiger Shroff. The event happened Sunday evening as Shroff exited a Juhu football club, with police later detaining seven additional people in Haryana.

item.title: FWICE Sends Letter to PM Modi Regarding Daler Mehndi
item.description: The Federation of Western India Cine Employees reached out to Prime Minister Narendra Modi to back singer Daler Mehndi. The organization emphasized the need for careful handling of artists' health following a public episode.

item.title: Jailer 2 Reaches Major Box Office Milestone
item.description: Starring Rajinikanth and Mohanlal, the movie Jailer 2 surpassed Rs 582 crore globally within seven days. Its domestic earnings crossed Rs 300 crore despite a minor drop in ticket sales during its seventh week.

item.title: United States Alleges Canadian Meddling
item.description: Washington pointed to Canadian trade tariffs, political gatherings, and anti-Trump advertisements as proof of electoral interference. The accusations come prior to upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: Putin Holds Talks With Witkoff and Kushner
item.description: Witkoff and Kushner met with Vladimir Putin for a fresh round of diplomatic negotiations. The discussions arrive amid rising anxieties in Kyiv regarding diminishing US backing for Ukraine.

item.title: State Bank of India Acknowledges Security Breach
item.description: SBI verified a data breach after cybersecurity monitors reported leaked files on the dark web. The bank confirmed that 4,000 customer files were exposed by a threat actor known as Siriusim.

item.title: Vishal's Hanuman Ansh Hits Rs 451 Crore Globally
item.description: Premiering on August 7, 2026, the movie Hanuman Ansh collected Rs 451 crore worldwide by its 77th day. Domestic net receipts totaled Rs 341.04 crore, while international earnings reached Rs 48.60 crore.

item.title: Irish Parliament Passes Bill Removing UN Mandate for Foreign Military Deployments
item.description: Legislators in Ireland passed a bill by 79 to 71 on Wednesday to remove the mandate for UN authorization prior to sending troops abroad. While supporters advanced the measure, critics from the opposition argued the decision endangers the nation's neutral stance.

item.title: Online Marketplace eBay Announces Another 1,000 Workforce Reductions
item.description: E-commerce platform eBay is eliminating another 1,000 positions. This follows an earlier round of 800 job cuts announced in February, prior to which the company reported a workforce of 12,300 personnel at the close of 2025.

item.title: YouTube Denies Conducting Tests to Conceal Video Dislike Counts
item.description: A representative for YouTube stated on Wednesday that the platform is not experimenting with hiding dislike buttons. The clarification followed user reports on social media suggesting the dislike metric was being relocated to the secondary options menu.

item.title: Cricketer Rabada Reaches 200 Test Wickets at Home Faster Than Dale Steyn
item.description: Fast bowler Rabada has achieved 200 wickets in 38 home Test matches with an average of 20.06, reaching the milestone using fewer deliveries than Dale Steyn. He joins South African bowling greats Steyn, Makhaya Ntini, and Shaun Pollock in this elite group.

item.title: Pacer Arshdeep Singh Nears Historic 150 T20I Wicket Milestone for India
item.description: Left-arm bowler Arshdeep Singh requires five more scalps to reach 150 wickets in T20 internationals ahead of a series against New Zealand. Currently holding 145 wickets across 99 matches, he is also approaching 300 total wickets in the format.

item.title: Kansas City Chiefs Begin 2026 NFL Season With Five Wins Despite Tough Schedule Ahead
item.description: Following a difficult 2025 season, quarterback Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs commenced the 2026 NFL campaign with five consecutive victories. Upcoming matches against formidable teams such as the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos will test their winning streak.

item.title: Vijay Deverakonda Starrer 'Ranabaali' Reaches Rs 59.65 Crore in Global Collections
item.description: The film 'Ranabaali', featuring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna after its October 16 release, accumulated a global total of Rs 59.65 crore. On its sixth day, box office collections dropped from Rs 7.10 crore to Rs 5.50 crore.

item.title: Tesla Sets Timeline for Customer Vehicles in Robotaxi Fleet
item.description: Tesla announced during its third-quarter earnings call that vehicle owners may incorporate their cars into its autonomous taxi network next year. Elon Musk has previously made repeated pledges regarding this unsupervised self-driving feature.

item.title: Actor Govinda Visits Puri Jagannath Temple to Offer Prayers on Vijayadashami
item.description: Bollywood actor Govinda traveled to the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri to offer prayers during the Vijayadashami celebrations. Crowds of supporters gathered to greet him upon arrival, and the actor stated he prayed for his children and thanked for the visit.
